hero_subtitle: Little Switzerland in the Middle Atlas — cedar forests, clean mountain air and alpine charm.

overview.title: Ifrane: Alpine Gardens, Cedar Forests and Mountain Lakes
overview.p1: Nestled at 1,650 meters in the Middle Atlas, Ifrane offers a complete contrast to Morocco's imperial cities and desert dunes. Known for its sloping red-roofed chalets, manicured gardens and cool mountain air, it is a serene haven for nature lovers, hikers and travellers seeking a refreshing mountain retreat.
overview.p2: Two to three days give you ample time to stroll the town's immaculate avenues, visit the nearby cedar forests to spot Barbary macaques, explore the scenic shores of Dayet Aoua, or enjoy winter sports at Michlifen.

places.title: Must-Visit Places in Ifrane
places.subtitle: Alpine landmarks, mountain lakes, cedar forests and scenic valleys.

lion.title: Stone Lion
lion.desc: Ifrane’s famous sculpture carved into the rock in the town centre.

aoua.title: Dayet Aoua
aoua.desc: Mountain lake surrounded by oak forests, popular for walks and birdwatching.

cedar.title: Cedar Forest
cedar.desc: Majestic Atlas cedars and home to friendly Barbary macaques.

michlifen.title: Michlifen
michlifen.desc: Volcanic crater and ski resort offering panoramic highland views.

vittel.title: Source Vittel
vittel.desc: Refreshing natural spring park set among lush greenery.

uni.title: Al Akhawayn University
uni.desc: Prestigious American-style university campus with beautiful alpine architecture.

tizguit.title: Tizguit Valley
tizguit.desc: Scenic river valley ideal for peaceful walks and nature escapes.

hachlaf.title: Dayet Hachlaf
hachlaf.desc: A tranquil, off-the-beaten-path lake on the mountain plateau.

park.title: Ifrane National Park
park.desc: Protected natural reserve featuring hiking trails and rich biodiversity.

itinerary.title: Suggested 3-Day Itinerary
itinerary.subtitle: A relaxed schedule to experience the highlights of Ifrane and the Middle Atlas.

detailed_itinerary.day1_md: Start at the iconic stone lion sculpture and walk through the clean garden-city avenues; visit Source Vittel park to see the town's natural springs.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ad: Admire the American-style university architecture from the exterior, then relax with coffee in the town square.
detailed_itinerary.day1_ed: Enjoy a warm dinner at a local restaurant — Ifrane evenings cool down quickly even in summer.
detailed_itinerary.day2_md: Head out to Dayet Aoua for peaceful shore walks and birdwatching in the morning light.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ad: Continue into the ancient cedar forest to see the majestic trees and observe wild Barbary macaques in their natural habitat.
detailed_itinerary.day2_ed: Unwind at your hotel or riad after a refreshing day in nature.
detailed_itinerary.day3_md: Drive up to Michlifen for panoramic mountain views, hiking trails, or winter skiing if visiting in season.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ad: Explore the lush landscapes and streams of the Tizguit Valley before returning to town.
detailed_itinerary.day3_ed: Prepare for your onward journey to Fes, Meknes, or deeper into the Atlas mountains.

eat.title: Where to Eat in Ifrane
eat.subtitle: Town square cafés, mountain grills and cozy alpine dining rooms.

gardens.title: Central Garden Cafés
gardens.desc: Mint tea and relaxed meals overlooking the central gardens and fountains.

grill.title: Mountain Grills & Tagines
grill.desc: Hearty local tagines and grilled meats ideal for cooler mountain weather.

brasserie.title: Alpine Brasseries
brasserie.desc: Cafés and brasseries serving coffee, pastries and warm dishes near the centre.

transport.title: Getting Around
transport.desc: The town centre is easily explored on foot. For visiting lakes, Michlifen, and the cedar forest, hiring a private taxi or joining an excursion is recommended.

bargain.title: Nature Etiquette
bargain.desc: When visiting the cedar forest, enjoy watching the Barbary macaques from a distance and avoid feeding them to protect their natural diet.

water.title: Packing for Altitude
water.desc: Due to its altitude (1,650 m), evenings in Ifrane can turn chilly even during warmer months. Always pack a light jacket or sweater.

daytrips.title: Best Day Trips from Ifrane
daytrips.subtitle: Explore nearby cedar markets, imperial history, and mountain peaks.

azrou.title: Azrou & Cedar Forest
azrou.desc: Famous market town and deep cedar woods just south of Ifrane.

fes.title: Fes
fes.desc: About an hour away — dive into the vibrant medieval medina.

michlifen.title: Michlifen & Jbel Hebri
michlifen.desc: High volcanic plateaus, winter sports and expansive alpine views.

q1.question: How many days should I spend in Ifrane?
q1.answer: Two to three days are ideal for exploring the town, visiting the cedar forests, lakes, and enjoying a relaxing mountain break.

q2.question: Is Ifrane safe for tourists?
q2.answer: Yes, Ifrane is widely recognized as one of the safest, cleanest, and most peaceful towns in Morocco.

q3.question: Can I see snow in Ifrane?
q3.answer: Yes! During winter (December to February), Ifrane frequently receives snow, making nearby Michlifen a popular destination for skiing and winter landscapes.

q4.question: How do I get to Ifrane from Fes?
q4.answer: Ifrane is easily accessible from Fes via grand taxis, private transfers, or buses, with the journey taking approximately 1 to 1.5 hours through scenic mountain roads.
